messages:
tara: trying to run `redwoodctl local-serve --container podman` on Fedora with rootless podman and it fails to pick up my token. getting `open /home/tara/.config/redwood/token: permission denied`. anyone hit this?
sam: hmm, rootless podman mounts home into the container differently. are you bind-mounting ~/.config? what does `podman run -v ~/.config/redwood:/root/.config/redwood` look like in your compose?
tara: I'm using the `--mount` that local-serve generates, so not hand-editing. here's the error log: `2026-02-20T14:12:01Z error failed to read token: open /root/.config/redwood/token: permission denied`
mike: ask: did you manage your dotfiles with chezmoi or a symlinked git bare repo? those tweak perms.
tara: yes, chezmoi symlinked `~/.config/redwood` to `~/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_config/redwood`. files are symlinks to the chezmoi store (owner me, but target is readonly root-owned dir?).
elinor: I think podman rootless uses a fuse overlay when mounting symlinks, and the container root (in user namespace) can't follow the symlink owner mapping -> permission denied. Seen something similar with ~/.ssh.
sam: quick repro: make a symlinked config dir and start rootless podman container reading it. If the target is outside your user subuid range, the container sees different uid/gid.
tara: workaround for me: `env REDWOOD_CONFIG_DIR=~/.redwood-local redwoodctl local-serve --mount-config` and copy the token into the non-symlink dir. works. but annoying for onboarding.
mike: file a DX bug. this will bite customers using dotfile managers. Also affects CI in our dev images where we populate config via symlink.
elinor: small proposal: local-serve should detect symlink mounts and prefer to copy config into a temp dir inside user's homedir (preserving perms) before mounting into container for rootless flows. fallback flag `--copy-config`?
sam: agreed. also add a check in `redwoodctl doctor` that warns when `~/.config/redwood` is a symlink. Could show `chezmoi`/`stow` heuristics.
tara: created a quick patch locally, will open PR tomorrow.
dev-bot: created issue DX-1452: "local-serve: handle symlinked config / rootless podman mounts (token permission denied)" assigned to @sam, priority P2. :white_check_mark:
sam: thx. can you include a small repro script in the issue (symlink + podman run) and paste the exact error lines? that'll speed fix.
tara: will do. thanks all :raised_hands:
